primitive_basis.definition: A primitive is a content-addressed executable semantic contract, not a package ID. Its fingerprint is computed from immutable skill content, examples/generator hints, rules/solver rules, validator implementation and validator specification, excluding mutable sampling/evolution statistics.
primitive_basis.support_predicate: For each content-addressed primitive u, V_u(x)=1 iff its frozen first-party validator accepts semantic task/context x under the released contract. A_u={x:V_u(x)=1}.
primitive_basis.independence_from_taxonomy: Package names/IDs do not enter primitive fingerprints or V_u. A taxonomy transformation in the claimed class cannot modify primitive content, validator code, or A_u.

taxonomy_representation.definition: A taxonomy T is a finite set of control package identities S_T together with a grouping relation M_T(s) subseteq U saying which frozen primitives are exposed by package s.
claimed_transformation_class: identity duplication: multiple package identities may point to the same primitive fingerprint
package grouping/merge: one macro package may expose multiple unchanged primitive fingerprints
package ungrouping: a macro package may be represented by separate packages for the same unchanged primitive fingerprints
not_claimed: arbitrary semantic decomposition of one primitive applicability set into newly invented subskills
transformations that change primitive implementation content or validator predicates
transformations that add a new executable capability/support predicate
taxonomy_representation.semantics_preserving_condition: The content-addressed primitive set U and every V_u/A_u remain exactly unchanged; only package identity/grouping and control responsibility change.

representation_channel.package_selection: p_T(s|z) is the probability of choosing control package s at frozen pre-task state z.
representation_channel.within_package_responsibility: rho_T(u|s,z)>=0 is supported only for u in M_T(s) and sums to one over primitives exposed by s. Singleton packages have rho=1. A macro merge used in P0 freezes rho=1/2,1/2 for its two unchanged primitives.
representation_channel.primitive_mass: m_T(u|z)=sum_s p_T(s|z) rho_T(u|s,z). Under the normalized responsibility channel, sum_u m_T(u|z)=1.
representation_channel.why_needed: A macro package cannot be treated as giving its full selection probability independently to every constituent primitive; the explicit responsibility channel defines the representation-to-primitive pushforward.

support_quotient.equivalence_relation: For semantic contexts x,x' in X, x ~_U x' iff V_u(x)=V_u(x') for every frozen primitive u in U.
support_quotient.quotient_space: C_U = X / ~_U. Each support cell c is identified by the primitive support signature sigma_U(c)={u:V_u(x)=1 for x in c}.
support_quotient.well_defined: Equality of finite Boolean support signatures is reflexive, symmetric and transitive, so ~_U is an equivalence relation. Because U and V_u are frozen, C_U is invariant to package duplication/grouping/ungrouping in the claimed transformation class.

exposure_objects.eligibility_exposure: For support cell c at frozen z, E_T(c|z)=sum_{u in sigma_U(c)} m_T(u|z). This is an additive control-opportunity measure and is not a probability distribution and not task utility.
exposure_objects.realized_task_distribution: Q_T(c|z) is the probability that the actual proposer/realization pipeline emits a qualified task in support cell c. Q is a probability distribution and is empirically distinct from E.
exposure_objects.credit_process: G_T records independently verified feedback on support cells/primitives. A representation-invariant credit rule must not duplicate total semantic credit when package identities are duplicated/regrouped.
exposure_objects.dynamic_process: The longitudinal distribution over realized support cells, verified outcomes and evolution state transitions is a separate empirical object; no static exposure theorem alone establishes its utility consequences.

stri_levels.STRI_E: eligibility/control exposure invariance under a frozen primitive basis
stri_levels.STRI_Q: realized qualified semantic-task distribution invariance under the first-party proposer/realization pipeline
stri_levels.STRI_G: semantic credit conservation/invariance under package regrouping
stri_levels.STRI_D: longitudinal/end-of-evolution outcome invariance; this is C4 and remains empirical

theorem_1.name: Mandatory-overlap additive-exposure lower bound
assumptions: nonnegative normalized primitive mass vector m induced by any one-primitive/package-first control law
there exist support cells c_a,c_b,c_ab with u_a in c_a only among {u_a,u_b}, u_b in c_b only among {u_a,u_b}, and both u_a,u_b in c_ab
positive exposure is retained on both exclusive cells
theorem_1.statement: Let r=min_c E(c)>0 over the focal supported cells. Exclusive cells force m(u_a)>=r and m(u_b)>=r. The overlap cell has E(c_ab)>=m(u_a)+m(u_b)>=2r, hence max_c E(c)/min_c E(c)>=2.
theorem_1.claim_boundary: This theorem is only about additive eligibility exposure E. It does not imply lower task accuracy, regret or end-of-evolution utility.

theorem_2.name: Frozen-state pre-context single-package controller reduction
assumptions: the upstream controller acts before the proposer task exists
the action space at the reviewed decision is exactly one current package identity
state z and available pre-decision information are frozen for the comparison
theorem_2.statement: Any randomized same-information controller at frozen state z is characterized by a categorical p_T(s|z). Combined with the fixed representation channel rho_T, it induces one nonnegative primitive-mass vector m_T(.|z), and therefore belongs to the additive exposure class constrained by Theorem 1 when the mandatory-overlap assumptions hold.
theorem_2.scope_limit: This is pointwise in frozen z. It does not identify or equate longitudinal adaptive controller policies whose state distribution evolves over time, and it does not prove dynamic/utility harm. P0-A/C4 test propagation through the actual evolution pipeline.
theorem_2.forbidden_inference: Do not claim that every longitudinal bandit/neural self-evolution algorithm is globally equivalent to one fixed categorical distribution.

sqc_minimal_object.control_object: A probability measure mu over frozen support quotient cells C_U, not over current package identities.
sqc_minimal_object.implementation_responsibility: alpha(u|c) is supported on u in sigma_U(c) and sums to one. It maps cell mass to unchanged primitive implementations without multiplying mass under package duplication.
sqc_minimal_object.package_realization: The current taxonomy only supplies a representation/realization channel from chosen primitive implementation to a package wrapper. Validator-gated rejection is a shared non-novel backend when no native cell-conditioned proposer exists.
sqc_minimal_object.credit_conservation: Independently verified feedback is written once to c/primitive responsibility and total responsibility sums to one before any package-specific bookkeeping.

claims_allowed_before_p0: C1: released systems exhibit package-identity representation sensitivity on tested control surfaces

C2: on the released Skill-SP focal graph, text dedup, exact-coverage package pruning and the entire frozen-state pre-context single-package additive-exposure class cannot remove the mandatory-overlap factor-2 residual
claims_locked: C3: SQC achieves realized/dynamic invariance without utility/coverage/resource loss
C4: static control representation sensitivity propagates to meaningful longitudinal/end-of-evolution outcomes
